bugs_found: fx_convert missing-rate branch is dead (`rate is None and False`), so absent rates raise Decimal conversion errors instead of the intended controlled validation
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount, effectively charging more than the transaction value
transfer is not atomic: debit is applied before credit, so a failure while updating account_to can leave balances inconsistent
compound_interest and loan_payment silently truncate non-integer years/months/compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial terms without validation
transfer does not normalize or validate amount as Decimal, so float/string/malformed inputs can raise late TypeError or mix unsupported numeric semantics
